milestones.label: Applications open for the 2027 cohort
milestones.source_text: The Yenching Academy's own admissions page says it takes applications for the 2027 cohort of Yenching Scholars from 1 September 2026.

milestones.label: Application deadline for international applicants
milestones.source_text: The Yenching Academy's admissions page gives this as the closing time for international candidates.

milestones.label: Application deadline for Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan applicants
milestones.source_text: The same official page sets a later closing time for applicants from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan. It gives no interview or decision dates.
